## Description

Prove the phase exit criteria hold together: resolver + close-batch CLI through real entries, skill docs, then Landing on primary.

## Approach

1. Run phase-scoped resolver and close-batch tests.
2. Grep/skill gates for plugin-root order and close-batch entry.
3. Confirm Landing (merge + store commit) with the human at phase close.
